title: First Draft: Donald Trump, Warmonger-in-Chief
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
_On this day in 1948, President Harry Truman formally created the Marshall
Plan, providing aid to European Cold War allies. In a move the current
president might question, Truman kept his name off the plan, instead using
bipartisan respect for Secretary of State George Marshall to smooth its
passage through Congress._

Good morning, **Mehdi** here. Thank goodness it's Friday? Normally, yes.
Normally, you can relax a bit at the end of the week. But during this war,
Fridays bring an ominous feeling to all of us here at **Team Zeteo**. Because
the weekends, with markets closed, are when Trump[ likes to
escalate](https://zeteo.com/p/gay-ayatollah-trump-story-first-draft). Will
this be the weekend, _[the long weekend](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-
investors-brace-for-uncertainty-over-the-upcoming-long-weekend-iran-
war-11941431)_ , that Trump decides to send ground forces into what could
become a
["](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/cGj7_oJgPII)**[bloodbath](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/cGj7_oJgPII)**["](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/cGj7_oJgPII)
for US troops? We'll be watching.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' **warmonger Trump** picks the military-
industrial complex over his own working-class base; women don't seem to last
long in the Trump administration; **Tiger Woods** calls Trump from the scene
of his DUI car crash; and **Hamas** refuses to disarm until Israel withdraws
its forces from **Gaza**.

Do you remember when private citizen Donald Trump and then 2016 presidential
candidate Donald Trump pretended to be anti-war? When he said US wars in the
Middle East had **" bled our country dry,"** and railed against** "wasting
lives and money" **overseas? When he repeatedly insisted that those billions
should be used at home to **" rebuild the USA"**?

Today, _President_ Donald Trump is spending billions of dollars _every single
day_ on his own illegal and catastrophic war of choice in the Middle East. One
online tracker puts the direct cost of his Iran war at almost [$40
billion](https://iran-cost-ticker.com/) in less than 40 days. The Trump
administration is already seeking more than [$200
billion](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/19/world/middleeast/pentagon-200-billion-
iran-war-funding-hegseth.html) in additional funding from Congress for the
Department of Defense, to pay for the war and to restock munitions.

But that's not all. Later today, the president of the United States will
unveil his [2027 White House
budget](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/02/business/economy/trump-budget-
spending.html), which is expected to feature a massive and unprecedented
escalation in defense spending across the board.

The expected 50% jump in Department of Defense spending, from [$1 trillion to
$1.5 trillion](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/01/07/trump-calls-record-
defense-budget-00715298), would mean the US would be spending roughly three
times as much on defense as all of the European members of NATO _combined_. It
would be the biggest increase in US defense spending since the Korean War and
would exceed the biggest year-on-year increases in Pentagon expenditures under
Republican hawks like Ronald Reagan (around 20% in 1983) and George W Bush
(around 15% in 2003).
